description: Records produced by the organizer's sample input generator (PS section 5, 'Sample-Input-generator-code-COLAB'; copy in data/organizer/). Units are taken from the organizer's field-name suffixes (_pct = percent, _ms = milliseconds). queue_drops, interface_errors and status are deliberately NOT mapped: the generator does not say whether the counts are running totals or per-interval counts, nor over what interval, and status is the generator's own label derived from the same metrics (using it would double-count). They are reported as UNMAPPED_FIELD on every ingestion.
